metrics.preferred_job_title: Social Media Manager | Influencer Campaign Manager
metrics.profile_summary: Experienced Social Media and Influencer Campaign Manager specializing in UGC strategies and creator partnerships. Proven track record in driving brand engagement and managing digital growth across major social platforms.

education.institution: Government college of economics and commerce

experience.description: Managed influencer campaigns, UGC strategies, and creator collaborations. Coordinated content approvals and monitored social media growth.
Handled backlink opportunities, personalized email outreach to webmasters, and managed contact databases for guest posting.
Implemented on-page/off-page SEO, conducted keyword research, and supported social media content coordination.

strengths: Direct experience with Meta Business Suite
Strong background in UGC and influencer coordination
Proficient in social media growth and content planning
weaknesses: Experience duration is borderline for the 2-year minimum
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a strong technical match with specific expertise in Meta Business Suite and social media management. Despite not having a completed Bachelor's degree, his practical experience in campaign execution and content coordination aligns well with the job requirements.
